      Travel to Maldives

      Experience the Pristine Beauty of the Maldives with Saudia Airlines

      Escape to a world where turquoise waters meet endless horizons. The Maldives invites you to discover a sanctuary of natural wonder and cultural depth. Whether you seek the thrill of the ocean or the quiet pulse of island life, your journey begins with the signature warmth and excellence of Saudia.


      1. Master The Art Of Maldivian Cooking

      Step into a local kitchen and learn the secrets of island flavors. Use fresh tuna and coconut to create authentic dishes that bring the taste of the tropics to your table.


      2. Dance To The Rhythm Of Boduberu

      Feel the heartbeat of the islands through traditional drumming. Join the locals in a rhythmic dance that celebrates the vibrant spirit and history of Maldivian heritage.


      3. Savor A Traditional Mas Huni Breakfast

      Start your morning with a true local favorite. Enjoy a fresh mixture of shredded tuna, onion, and chili served with warm roshi bread for a perfect tropical energy boost.


      4. Explore Vibrant Coral Reefs

      Plunge into a kaleidoscope of color beneath the waves. Swim alongside exotic sea turtles and schools of tropical fish in some of the most diverse marine ecosystems on the planet.


      5. Join A Guided Local Island Tour

      Walk through charming villages to experience the genuine hospitality of the Maldivian people. Discover hidden gems and learn about the daily traditions that make each atoll unique.


      6. Experience Authentic Alfresco Dining

      Dine under the stars with your toes in the sand. Relish the catch of the day prepared with local spices while the gentle ocean breeze elevates your evening meal.


      7. Discover Traditional Wood Carving Art

      Watch master craftsmen transform simple timber into intricate masterpieces. This ancient skill tells the story of the islands through beautiful patterns and expert handiwork.


      8. Sail On A Traditional Dhoni Boat

      Glance across the horizon from the deck of a classic wooden vessel. Navigating the crystal clear lagoons on a dhoni offers a timeless perspective of the archipelago beauty.


      9. Enjoy A Sunset Sandbank Picnic

      Find your own private paradise on a secluded strip of white sand. Watch the sky transform into shades of gold and violet while enjoying a curated selection of gourmet treats.


      10. Learn Sustainable Fishing Techniques

      Connect with the ocean using traditional pole and line methods. Discover how local communities protect their precious marine life while providing for their families with respect and care.

      Scroll to view more →

      Cities You Should Visit When Traveling to Maldives

      1. Malé

      Dive into the vibrant heart of the archipelago where history meets modern energy. Explore the stunning Old Friday Mosque, crafted from intricate coral stone, or wander through bustling local markets filled with the day’s freshest catch and tropical treasures. This island capital offers your first true glimpse into the authentic Maldivian way of life, blending ancient heritage with a bright, welcoming atmosphere.
